Width 256, four untied blocks, eight heads, FFN/decoder 1,024; 5,003,016 parameters. Core-local radial-shell graph nominal k=200, radius 500 um, bidirectional union, no self/cross-core edges; 70-D geometry adds attention-logit bias. Ten masks per core/epoch; each cell masks Uniform{0,...,1000} genes without replacement. Masked Huber delta=1; AdamW lr=1e-4, wd=1e-5, clip=1, dropout=0.1, no LR scheduler. Eight independent blocks, expected 8,199,464 params; planned seed 0 under original SO2 plateau protocol, with operational review if e300 reached without plateau.
performance: Not trained: no run or performance found.
caveats: Configuration and frozen design exist; no authoritative registry run or finalized checkpoint found. Do not count as a trained model.
